user.description: The operating system user to run the NZBGet process as.

password.description: The control password for the NZBGet server.

bind_address.description: The IP address for the control interface to bind to.

control_port.description: The TCP port for the control interface.

web_interface_ip.description: The IP address for the web interface to bind to.

web_interface_port.description: The TCP port for the web interface.

enable_web_interface.description: Whether to enable the built-in web interface.

dest_dir.description: The main directory where completed downloads are stored.

temp_dir.description: The temporary directory for partial downloads.

max_downloads.description: The maximum number of concurrent active downloads.

incoming_port.description: The port NZBGet listens on for incoming news server connections (if acting as a news server).

enable_post_processing.description: Whether to enable automatic post-processing scripts.

enable_feeds.description: Whether to enable the internal feed reader.

feeds.description: A list of feed configurations to monitor for new content. Items are flat maps with 'name', 'url', and 'enabled' fields.
